title: The Goodbye at the Window until the Corner
youtube_title: The Goodbye at the Window until the Corner | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Pilar notices that Papa has already taken care of a someone staying at the window until you turned the corner. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Pilar does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
